events.name: VO2max 5×3
events.notes: 5 × 3 min at 108% FTP with equal easy spinning between. Hard but even: the last rep should match the first, with HR reaching about 158+ bpm by the end. If you cannot hold a rep, drop 3% for the rest of the set instead of stopping.
events.text:
Warmup
- 10m ramp 50%-70%
- 2m 85%
- 3m 60%

Main Set 5x
- 3m 108%
- 3m 55%

Cooldown
- 10m 65%
- 5m ramp 60%-45%

events.name: Sweet Spot 3×8
events.notes: 3 × 8 min at 90% FTP. Comfortably hard: full sentences are a struggle, but you could keep going. This is the main FTP builder, so keep the power steady.

- 2m 85%
- 3m 60%

Main Set 3x
- 8m 90%
- 4m 55%

Cooldown
- 12m 65%
- 5m ramp 60%-45%

events.name: Endurance 90
events.notes: Steady zone 2 with short tempo lifts to stay engaged. Conversational throughout, and HR should stay near or below 131 bpm outside the lifts. Ease off if it drifts higher.
